metrics.byteMeasurementScope: Consumed SDK object-download bytes and confirmed upload payload sizes; excludes HTTP overhead and retransmission.
unavailableMeasurements: Native AVFoundation HTTP wire bytes and requests
metrics.viewConstructionScope: SwiftUI view construction only; excludes layout, drawing and framework work after body returns.

scope: Actual monotonic cache/refresh durations and process peak memory; joined fake transport bytes/counts. Frame gap is a deterministic fixture, not a simulator scrolling measurement.
